Roommate Matching

University housing solutions designed by you.

Innovative Secure Social network that is truly designed by Housing administrators like you

Lifetopia Roommates offers a seamless student portal that allows individuals to search possible roommates, housing options, meal plans, and more. With our secure online social network, students can make connections with other classmates prior to setting foot on campus. Lifetopia Roommates offers the full spectrum of functionality and depth of criteria enabling students to self-select their roommates while empowering the school to include their business rules into the site's search logic and provide administrative oversight.

Secure Web based Roommate Matching

RoommateGateway offers the full spectrum of functionality and depth of criteria enabling students to self-select their roommates. Lifetopia offers your school the flexibility to incorporate your business process into the site's search logic and provide administrative oversight.
